title: Oscar and the Hymn
author: Beatrix Joubert
blurb: Ines Iversen, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the harvest moon rises.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
